subject: Physics
axis_note: ladder_position is a curriculum coordinate, never a learner estimate; the three rungs are a bounded owner-approved preparation slice and do not imply full JEE Vector Algebra coverage.

must_contain: Declared +x/+y axes tied explicitly to i-hat and j-hat.
At least one negative component whose sign is preserved as a basis-vector coefficient.
A reverse translation back to the original signed component pair.

controlled_variation.hold: the axis convention and the other component
controlled_variation.notice: only the coefficient of the matching basis vector changes sign

controlled_variation.hold: the same basis and physical vector description
controlled_variation.notice: a zero basis term may be written explicitly or omitted without changing the vector

must_contain: A quadrant or exact-axis decision made from signed components before inverse tangent is used.
An acute reference-angle expression based on positive component magnitudes.
A check that the reported direction has the original component sign pattern.
An axis case that avoids division by a zero component.

controlled_variation.vary: the signs of v_x and v_y while keeping their magnitudes fixed
controlled_variation.notice: the reference angle stays the same while the final directed quadrant changes

controlled_variation.vary: one component from nonzero to zero
controlled_variation.notice: the direction becomes an exact axis and the inverse-tangent ratio is no longer needed

must_contain: An explicit |v|>0 domain check before normalization.
The same positive magnitude dividing every signed component.
A zero-vector boundary case that refuses normalization.

controlled_variation.vary: the overall positive scale of the original nonzero vector
the original vector from nonzero to zero
controlled_variation.notice: the operation becomes undefined because the denominator is zero and no direction exists

family.invariant_demand: Preserve one declared 2-D axis system while translating signed components into compact basis notation, recovering a quadrant-correct direction, or removing scale to obtain a nonzero unit direction.
family.difficult_move: Keeping directional information separate from calculator output or scale: signs fix the quadrant, basis coefficients keep their signs, and normalization uses one positive common denominator only after excluding the zero vector.
family.independent_check: Translate back to signed components, compare the reported direction with the component sign pattern, and verify a normalized vector has magnitude 1.

support_ladder.handed_over: The axes, basis meanings, target operation and the relevant symbolic relation are supplied.
The axes and target operation are supplied, but the learner must choose the sign/quadrant or common normalization factor.
Only the signed vector information and requested output are supplied; the learner must select notation, quadrant handling and normalization checks independently.

transfer.changed_demand: A vector is given as an ordered pair and must be rewritten in i-hat/j-hat notation before another step.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: which signed component multiplies each basis vector

transfer.changed_demand: A resultant is given only by signed components and the direction must be reported from +x without a method label.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: the quadrant-first decision and whether an axis case bypasses inverse tangent

transfer.changed_demand: A nonzero vector appears in an unfamiliar physical context and the learner is asked only for a direction vector of magnitude 1.
transfer.information_not_handed_over: that the requested object is obtained by one common positive normalization factor
